scope: Route B only; research design review, no implementation

prior_verification_state.scope: Independent synthetic 20/40/80/160^2 and microcase 20/40/80^2 serial DP ASCII16 first ten SIMPLE iterations; not steady QoI sensitivity.

error_categories.numerical_floor: Measurement/reproduction limits from finite precision, arithmetic evaluation, IO/parser/restart; only partly quantified. Reducible linear-solve error is not automatically an unavoidable floor.
error_categories.solver_capability: Achievable conservation error for specified grid, state, linear tolerance, stopping reason, precision and solver; distinct from physical acceptance.
error_categories.research_acceptance_budget: Independent allowance for conservation-related influence on scientific conclusions/QoIs, with scope and uncertainty; not obtained by multiplying observed floor by an arbitrary factor.

qoi_mapping_review.conclusion: No general scalar epsilon_phi-to-QoI relative/position error proportional guarantee.
qoi_mapping_review.conditional_linearized_relation: For a nonsingular gauge-fixed coupled system and smooth QoI near a converged discrete solution: delta_Q approximately lambda_Q^T*r, J^T*lambda_Q=grad_Q. Continuity contribution <= ||lambda_Q,c||_infinity*(Up*V_total/L)*epsilon_mean, with additional residuals and nonlinear remainder.
limitations: Sensitivity depends on QoI/grid/Ra/state/BC/branch and defect location/sign.
Extreme positions may be nonsmooth or ambiguous.
Continuity alone does not ensure momentum/temperature equation accuracy.
Equation units/scaling must be accounted for in coupled residual sensitivity.

budget_A.advantage: Clear whole-domain L1 criterion, directly tied to corrected phi.
budget_A.limitation: Known isolated defects can be diluted; no mandatory investigation.

budget_B.advantage: Directly limits isolated cell source-rate defects.
budget_B.limitation: Requires an independent local physical budget, cell-size/scaling applicability and measured feasibility; same q defect grows as 1/Vi.

budget_C.investigation: Pre-registered local max/ratio/pattern and boundary/closure triggers; trigger is not automatic Gate FAIL.
budget_C.advantage: Mandatory investigation of isolated defects without imposing unjustified fixed max Hard.
budget_C.limitation: Trigger cutoff, protocol and mean budget still unresolved.

budget_D.advantage: Potential separate closed-boundary net leakage constraint.
budget_D.limitation: Global <= mean in exact shared-incidence arithmetic; redundant when tau_global>=tau_mean. Net zero does not exclude opposing wall leaks. Tighter separate quota has no current numerical justification.
budget_D.combination_with_C: Possible after separate boundary quota justification, with absolute/patch wall diagnostics retained.

recommended_architecture.hard_semantics: Exceeding adopted Hard threshold means Gate FAIL; no adopted threshold exists here.
recommended_architecture.trigger_semantics: Investigate and document location/cause/impact; not automatic FAIL, not automatic clearance/PASS while review is pending.
recommended_architecture.diagnostic_semantics: Record and report; no standalone pass/fail consequence.

threshold_field_semantics: tau_max and tau_global denote HARD cutoffs only. Their investigation cutoffs are separate unresolved parameters.
architecture_ready_scope: Roles and review workflow only; not an executable, adopted acceptance specification.

global_metric_review.hard_redundancy: tau_global>=tau_mean is redundant except arithmetic/IO inconsistency; tau_global<tau_mean is an additional independently justified requirement.
global_metric_review.boundary_counterexample: Equal inflow/outflow through opposite walls can have q=0 and B_net=0 while violating impermeability.
global_metric_review.recommended_role: Mandatory signed/net/absolute/patch diagnostics and closure/leakage investigation, no independent global Hard proposed.

grid_scaling.mean: Whole-domain sum(abs(q))/V_total; fixed isolated internal-face delta gives 2*abs(delta)/V_total, independent of grid.
grid_scaling.max: Cell source-rate max(abs(q)/Vi); fixed delta gives abs(delta)/(h^2*W).
grid_scaling.global: Boundary integral; internal delta cancels, boundary leakage contributes abs(delta)/V_total.
grid_scaling.cell_throughput_candidate: chi_i=abs(q_i)/(Up*A_char_i)=(ell_i/L)*epsilon_local_i, ell_i=Vi/A_char_i. Square extruded active side face gives ell=h. Fixed chi and fixed epsilon_local impose different requirements.
scope_caveats: Global Up is a reference scale, not actual local throughput.
Actual local throughput may vanish at stagnation cells.
Exclude empty faces when defining A_char.
Nonuniform/aspect-ratio/orientation generalization requires new metric verification.

gate_alignment.D: Keep iterative/steady convergence, monitoring window and residual criteria; conservation does not replace them.
gate_alignment.E: Keep paper comparison tolerance and absolute position rules; do not copy 1% to continuity or assume all 1% is available error budget.
gate_alignment.F: Compare conservation-induced QoI impact with the SAME QoI discretization uncertainty; never compare epsilon directly with GCI/10.
gate_alignment.G: Keep heat/section/symmetry criteria, decompose native phi conservation roles; reconstructed U stays proposed diagnostic.

sensitivity_experiment_scope: PLAN ONLY: independent Ra_test=30000 cavity, initially 20/40/80^2 serial DP ASCII16, no formal case/Ra/reference. Fully converged paired pressure-tolerance runs plus separately scoped controlled zero-net continuity residual patterns. Assess relative Nu_bar_cavity/Nu_0/Nu_half/Umax/Wmax and absolute extrema-position impact with baseline, iteration, grid and serialization uncertainty. Certified sensitivity/error bounds could substitute for empirical work.

independent_acceptance_quotas.selection: Research purpose and acceptable QoI impact specified before examining benchmark conservation values.

sensitivity_plan.baseline: Establish steady QoI and other equation convergence and bound baseline error; prior ten-iteration suite is insufficient.
sensitivity_plan.arm_1: Pressure tolerance 1e-6/1e-8/1e-10, relTol=0, all other setup fixed, fully converged same-grid QoI differences; trajectory confounding explicitly assessed.
sensitivity_plan.arm_2: Verification-only maintained known zero-net residual/flux patterns with paired cell defects and spread/local/near-wall/centre/reference locations. Explicitly specify altered equation/state timing; one-time pressure-projected or frozen-field perturbations do not measure coupled response.
sensitivity_plan.boundary_leakage: Treat as separate BC verification, not closed-domain QoI calibration.
sensitivity_plan.qoi_error_evaluation: Upper-envelope estimate of conservation-related QoI impact with uncertainty in same QoI units; no undocumented RSS independence assumption.
sensitivity_plan.threshold_selection: Pre-register scope/candidate rules; impact plus uncertainty must satisfy independent b_Q for every selected QoI and tested pattern/state. Finite experiments do not certify arbitrary untested patterns.
sensitivity_plan.scope_extension: Single Ra_test and microcase grids do not justify automatic application to all formal Ra, 160^2 or future 320^2.

assumptions: Route B constant reference density and native volume flux.
Shared oriented face incidence for global/mean inequality.
Uniform square extruded mesh for explicit h-scaling examples.
Positive Up for normalized Ra>0 metrics; Ra=0 uses Gate C.
Coupled linearized QoI explanation requires gauge fixing, consistent scaling, smoothness and nonsingular branch.
limitations: No independent mean/local QoI quota supplied or justified.
No sensitivity or adjoint computation performed.
Prior operator/mapping tests do not establish steady QoI impact.
Trigger cutoffs remain unresolved despite role architecture readiness.
No universal numerical floor or arbitrary Ra/grid certification.
Global net cannot detect balanced wall leakage or local defects.
ASME public guidance reviewed, no claim of full ASME V&V20/AIAA original-standard audit.
Author preprint abstract only, not cited as a verified theorem.
solver_rerun_scope: No solver execution in this task; no existing benchmark rerun required. Future independent sensitivity experiment is planned but not executed.
required_user_decision: Use Budget C roles as the next-stage design basis, without formal adoption.
Specify independent QoI impact quotas and applicability scope.
